branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not change the lexical meaning of قَالَ.

findings.title: The added Fatiha ayat widen the knowledge horizon
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 places the focus's knowing word beside the same root's name for the worlds, allowing Allah's knowledge of their acts to be heard against the wider created whole.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier عَلِيمٌ at 12:19:14 meets العَالَمِينَ at 1:2:4, which activates the supplied focus branch for the universe and all created beings and returns through the focus knowledge word.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the final knowing clause as locally about the caravan's acts while its named knowledge word opens toward the wider world named in the external overlay.
findings.containment: This is a qualified external overlay inference. It does not translate عَلِيمٌ as العَالَمِينَ, change the grammar of 12:19, or import the rest of Fatiha as an undifferentiated whole-surah theme.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is accepted and both exact root-bearing occurrences are supplied, while the changed horizon is an overlay inference rather than a candidate source record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: عَلِيمٌ carries the focus's stable knowing predicate.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ supplies the external world's-whole occurrence under the same root.
branch_activations.activation: The external worlds occurrence activates the focus branch for the created whole and sends that scope back through the focus knower.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Allah's knowing remains directed to what they do while acquiring a bounded resonance of awareness against the wider created domain.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not make the focus adjective a noun for worlds or erase its local knowledge predicate.

findings.title: The added Fatiha ayat give Allah an address of worship
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 and 1:5 place the focus's named Allah in a worship-and-appeal relation: the one named as the knowing subject is also the one addressed as worshiped and asked for help.
findings.mechanism: The focus Allah carrier at 12:19:13 meets the external Allah naming in 1:2:2 and the worship act in 1:5:2; the accepted tapınılan-varlık facet returns the devotional relation through the focus name.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the focus's knowledge clause within an overlay where the named subject is not only known about but directly addressed as the worshiped recipient of dependence.
findings.containment: This is a qualified external overlay. The ordinary proper-name subject and knowledge clause remain intact; the finding adds a worship/appeal relation without turning the focus into a prayer sentence or importing unlisted external ayat.

epistemic.reason: The focus proper-name carrier and both external trigger occurrences are supplied, and the focus branch is accepted, while the devotional relation is an overlay inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱللَّهُ carries the focus's explicit divine proper-name subject.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The external Allah naming and إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ supply the named worship recipient and the worship act.
branch_activations.activation: The focus name meets the external worship address, activating the facet of the named worshiped being and giving the knowing subject a devotional relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Allah's knowledge of their acts can be heard within an address that also turns toward him in worship and dependence.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus remains a declarative knowledge clause; this overlay does not rewrite it as an imperative or prayer.
